messages:
rita: Brain dump: propose an inline "fallback quick card" on rollout rows. Purpose: immediate signal + tiny actions without leaving list.

omar: What minimal info? Keep it micro.

rita: Fields: mode (degrade/redirect/noop), trigger short (e.g., p95>1s), sample%, fallback variant, est cost delta, audit id copy. Tap expands small panel with causal trace + last metric point.

lynn: Must differentiate snapshot vs live. Snapshots are the single source of truth for audits. Add text: "snapshot @ ISO_TS".

dev-ops-bot: policy-eval: snap=fb-20260325-77 policy=auto-fallback v3.9 trigger=p95>1s sample=2% fallback=small-v2 cost=+$0.30/1k

zach: Action design: preview (sandbox), open runbook, and escalate. Gate preview to can_preview; escalate to operator. Every action returns action_id we append to the snapshot audit_actions.

omar: Backend: store flattened snapshot blobs (strings only) with TTL 90d and cap per-rollout (100 latest). Index by audit id for quick lookup.

lynn: Security: input_ref only (sha256 or secure pointer). If preview requires example inputs, use synthetic or opt-in customer copies with explicit consent.

rita: UX microcopy mock:
Rollout feat/short-reply  snapshot @2026-03-25T12:34Z
[SNAPSHOT] degrade | p95>1s | 2% | +$0.30/1k | audit:fb-20260325-77 [▸]
Popover shows 3-line causal chain, sparkline, and actions.

zach: I'll draft RBAC matrix and a tiny API: POST /rollouts/{id}/actions {action,comment} -> {action_id}. We log action_id in snapshot.

rita: Great. I'll add the mock and audit blob example to the design doc and schedule a short follow-up.

omar: Thx. Keep the popover compact and keyboard accessible.
